sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesia's 0.1% final tax on crypto transactions and licensed exchange framework (Bappebti) is cementing a compliant trading base, driving durable volume growth for regulated platforms.

Stablecoin regulation under Bank Indonesia's draft rules could reshape on/off-ramp liquidity, making compliant stablecoin pairs a key battleground for local exchanges and institutional flows.
sectors.ai: Accumulate selective large-cap alts (SOL, TAO) on strength; VET's +23% spike is speculative and likely to fade—take profits. Indonesia's crypto tax clarity (0.1% PPh final) supports compliant exchange volumes, but regulatory noise around stablecoins remains a tail-risk. Rotate into SOL for sustained DePIN/AI narrative exposure, and trim VET into the rally.
